name: Aethermaw Linnorm - Young
description: Young Aethermaw is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with armoured black plates and translucent cyan aether-sensing organs. It seeks to feed on concentrated aether in the deep. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Armoured Bite
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Aether Scent
abilities.description: The linnorm senses the direction of active concentrated aether within Far range, even through water or a ship’s hull.

abilities.name: Scalding Brine
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 physical damage and the target marks 1 Stress from scalding brine and shell shards. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the linnorm marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
